'Tākou' Himiona Tūpākihi Kāmira
'Tākou' Himiona Tūpākihi Kāmira
'
Tākou
'
Himiona Tūpākihi Kāmira
(1876/77 – 28 August 1953 as noted on his headstone at Matihetihe marae). Tākou as he was commonly known was a Māori
tohunga
, historian and genealogist. Of
Māori
descent, his principal Hapū were Te Taomauī and Te Hokokeha, and his
Iwi
were
Te Rarawa
,
Te Aupōuri
,
Ngāti Kahu
,
Ngāti Whātua
and
Ngāpuhi
. He was born in Reena,
Northland
,
New Zealand
.
